description:
rein-klaʊd brings the Rein operator console to iPhone and iPad while your agent and tools keep running on hardware you control.

Connect to a private Rein gateway, open a named agent, and continue its durable conversation. Streaming replies identify operator input, agent responses, and tool execution. Actions that require approval under your Rein policy open a native allow-or-deny prompt. A host run continues if the phone locks or changes networks.

Add your own API accounts for direct text conversations from the phone. Supported connections include self-hosted OpenAI-compatible servers, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, and OpenRouter. API keys are stored in this device's Keychain. Direct chat has no host tools, command execution, or background autonomy.

Authorize supported cloud subscriptions through an official CLI on your connected Rein host. Open the provider's device-verification page on the phone, approve the sign-in, then select that host provider. ChatGPT uses Codex, GitHub Copilot uses Copilot CLI, and eligible Grok subscriptions use Grok Build. The CLI keeps its credentials on the host. Subscription access and limits are determined by each provider.

Save backup hosts and API accounts for connection failures. Automatic fallback is off by default. When enabled, a new request can use a backup host or direct API connection. A different host retains your draft for review before you send it. Tasks with unknown delivery are never replayed on another host or provider. Direct API fallback can incur provider charges. Including recent visible host text is a separate optional setting; tool results are excluded.

The interface carries Rein's field-guide design into a native mobile layout with Light and Night themes, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver support, and optional vintage computer sounds. Direct conversations are saved in protected local files excluded from backups.

rein-klaʊd does not provide a hosted AI service. You choose the Rein hosts and API providers that receive your messages. Zermo does not receive your conversations.
promotionalText: Carry your durable Rein sessions between desk, phone, and tablet while execution stays on your own host.
